translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Sidh ne ruoth adiera mari, yaye Nyasaye,
sidh ne wuod ruoth timni makare.
Obiro ngʼado ne jou bura makare,
obiro kelo adiera ne jou masandore.
Gode biro kelo mwandu ne ji,
kendo thuche biro kelo olemb tim makare.
Obiro chwako joma odhier manie dier ji
kendo obiro reso nyithind joma ochando;
to thiro ji, to obiro tieko pep.
Obiro siko ka wangʼ chiengʼ,
obiro siko ka dwe e tienge duto.
Obiro chalo gi koth machwe e lum mongʼadi maber
kendo gi kodh ajiki mamiyo piny ngʼich.
E ndalone joma kare biro dhi maber,
kendo kwe biro bedo mogundho nyaka chop dwe lal nono.
Obiro bedo gi loch chakre nam nyaka nam
kendo kochakore Aora maduongʼ nyaka kuma piny ogikie.
Ogendini modak e piny ongoro biro kulorene
kendo wasike biro nangʼo lowo gi dhogi.
Ruodhi mag Tarshish kod mag dho nembe man maboyo
biro miye gik moko,
kendo ruodhi mag Sheba gi mag Seba
biro kelone mich.
Ruodhi duto biro kulorene
kendo ogendini duto biro tiyone.
Nimar obiro konyo joma ochando maywagore,
jogo modhier maonge gi jakony.
Obiro kecho joma ok nyal gi joma ochando
kendo obiro reso ngima joma ochando.
Obiro gologi e dich modigigo kendo e timbe mahundu,
nimar okwano rembgi ka gima nengone tek.
Mad odag amingʼa!
Mad kelne dhahabu moa Sheba.
Mad ji duto sik ka lamone
kendo ka gwedhe odiechiengʼ duto.
Mad cham bed mangʼeny e piny duto,
bende gikwak nyaka wi godo matindo duto.
Mad olembene ol mathoth ka Lebanon,
kendo mad onyagi ka lum manie pap.
Mad nyinge sik nyaka chiengʼ
kendo mad odhi nyime ka wangʼ chiengʼ.
Ogendini duto ibiro gwedhi gi gweth moa kuomi
kendo gibiro luongi ni ngʼat mogwedhi.
Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, mondo oyud opak,
en kende ema otimo gik miwuoro.
Nyinge man-gi duongʼ mondo opaki nyaka chiengʼ
kendo mad piny duto pongʼ gi duongʼne.
Ma e giko mag lamo mag Daudi Wuod Jesse.
